unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U28: Distinguish investigator rank,section17A approval and its exception

payload.title: Rank, prior approval and sanction answer different questions
payload.core_explanation_md:
Section17 specifies authorised investigator ranks and qualifications: the source distinguishes DSPE, the stated metropolitan category and other areas, with the specified State-authorisation route and additional illicit-enrichment investigation requirement. Establish the actual jurisdiction and authorisation rather than applying one rank everywhere.

Section17A concerns prior approval for the described inquiry/investigation into offences relatable to an official recommendation or decision. The appropriate approval authority depends on the employment/removal relationship. The on-the-spot arrest for accepting or attempting to accept undue advantage has the stated exception. The decision period is three months with the described reasoned one-month extension. The2021 SOP concerns processing; do not call it a fresh statutory amendment.

self_check.prompt_text: Does section 17A mean every on-the-spot bribery arrest first needs that approval?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The source specifies an exception for that situation.

payload.stem_md: An investigator invokes section 17A to insist on prior approval for the stipulated on-the-spot arrest while accepting an undue advantage. Which qualification matters?

options.text_md: The bank may grant any police power

options.explanation_md: It must be distinguished from the official-decision approval route.
Undue advantage is not confined to cash.

payload.correct_explanation_md: It must be distinguished from the official-decision approval route.

payload.stem_md: A file has section 17A approval but no evidence that the investigating officer meets the section 17 rank/authorisation requirements. What remains?

options.explanation_md: Approval does not erase the rank and authorisation provisions.

options.text_md: Nothing; any person may investigate after any approval
options.explanation_md: Prior approval does not replace the separate statutory investigator-rank and authorisation requirements.
It does not prove statutory power.
Investigative authority does not decide guilt.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Approval does not erase the rank and authorisation provisions.
